newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

* The Dow Jones industrial average ended at 6,521.70 on Monday, after falling about 49 points earlier in the session, as a broad rally in retailing shares rescued the market from a sharp sell-off sparked by strong economic reports.
* Chairman of the unrecognized Democratic People's Party Budiman Sudjatmika and nine other people will soon be tried for allegedly masterminding the July 27 riots in Jakarta.

* The Jakarta Composite Index rose 3.16 points, or 0.51 percent, to close at 616.17 points on Monday following bargain-hunting of some blue-chips coupled with speculative buying of certain secondaries.
* Brokers said the market was likely to be moving sideways on Tuesday, with focus likely to remain on some big-capitalised stocks including Indosat and Bank Negara Indonesia.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,345.50/45.75 in early trading against the opening of 2,345.25/46.00.
* Indosat on news of cuts in international telephone rates.
* Astra Graphia on market talk that the firm was likely to announce a rights issue and that it had won a lucrative deal.
* Indofood on an announcement that it planned to acquire its principal distributor Indomarco early next year.
* Lippo Securities on posting a net profit of 26.12 billion rupiah in the first nine months of 1996 against 8.52 billion rupiah in the same period last year.
* Second-liner Hotel Prapatan on market talk of a possible rights issue.
